capabilities.label: Identity Contract
capabilities.description: Scenario display identity and cross-surface name consistency.

levels.name: No branding target
levels.description: Brand Manager cannot resolve a scenario or readable source tree to assess branding.
levels.capability_summary: Brand Manager cannot yet resolve a readable branding target.
levels.next_unlock: A readable target tree and completed branding scan.

levels.name: Display name declared
levels.description: The scenario declares a non-placeholder display name.
levels.capability_summary: The scenario declares the minimum brand identity every surface can render.
levels.next_unlock: Consistent naming across manifest, document, and scenario metadata.

levels.name: Identity cross-checked
levels.description: The scenario's display name can be compared across branding surfaces.
levels.capability_summary: Brand identity can be checked across core surfaces.
levels.next_unlock: Fully consistent naming across all branding surfaces.

levels.name: Identity consistent
levels.description: The scenario's display name is consistent across branding surfaces.
levels.capability_summary: Brand identity is declared and consistent across core surfaces.

capabilities.label: Visual System

levels.name: Visual system absent

levels.capability_summary: The scenario has no usable visual-system foundation.

levels.name: Color system present
levels.description: The scenario defines a canonical color-token contract.
levels.capability_summary: Core colors are declared in a reusable token system.
levels.next_unlock: Typography choices that make the brand recognizable.

levels.name: Typography declared
levels.description: The scenario declares typography or font-family decisions.
levels.capability_summary: The visual system includes typography decisions.
levels.next_unlock: Custom or intentionally self-hosted typeface evidence where the brand requires it.

levels.name: Typeface intentional
levels.description: The scenario has enough color and typography structure for consistent brand application.
levels.capability_summary: Color and typography are ready for consistent brand application.

capabilities.label: Brand Assets
capabilities.description: Logo, favicon, Apple touch icon, referenced assets, template residue, SVG safety, and public asset convention.

levels.name: Brand assets absent
levels.description: No usable visible brand assets are present.
levels.capability_summary: Visible brand assets are missing.

levels.name: Core marks present
levels.description: Logo and favicon surfaces are present.
levels.capability_summary: Core browser and product marks are present.
levels.next_unlock: Valid referenced assets with template residue removed.

levels.name: Assets coherent
levels.description: Brand assets exist, references resolve, generated-template residue is removed, and SVGs are safe.
levels.capability_summary: Brand assets are present, referenced correctly, and safe to serve.
levels.next_unlock: Public install/share asset convention and home-screen icon readiness.

levels.name: Assets publishable
levels.description: Brand assets are valid, conventionally served, and ready for public/install surfaces.
levels.capability_summary: Visible brand assets are publishable across browser, install, and share surfaces.

capabilities.label: Accessibility and Application
capabilities.description: Contrast, reduced-motion support, color-scheme declaration, and evidence that the brand has been applied.

levels.name: Accessibility posture unknown
levels.description: Brand accessibility cannot be evaluated yet.
levels.capability_summary: Brand accessibility posture is unknown.
levels.next_unlock: Readable color pairings for contrast evaluation.

levels.name: Light contrast readable
levels.description: Core light-mode color pairings meet WCAG AA contrast.
levels.capability_summary: Light-mode color contrast is readable.
levels.next_unlock: Dark-mode contrast and browser color-scheme support.

levels.name: Accessible theming
levels.description: Light and dark themes are readable and declare browser color-scheme/reduced-motion support.
levels.capability_summary: Brand theming is accessible across color scheme and motion preferences.
levels.next_unlock: Evidence that brand-manager markers or manifest metadata apply the brand.

levels.name: Brand applied
levels.description: Accessible brand tokens are applied across the scenario through markers or manifest metadata.
levels.capability_summary: The brand is accessible and visibly applied.

capabilities.label: Install Surface

levels.name: Install branding absent

levels.capability_summary: Install branding metadata is absent.
levels.next_unlock: Theme color and standalone mobile metadata.

levels.name: Mobile chrome branded

levels.name: Install surface clean

levels.next_unlock: Open Graph and Twitter card metadata.

levels.name: Social metadata present

levels.capability_summary: Link previews can render branded metadata.

has-display-name.reason: A meaningful display name requires human/product judgment, not a deterministic default.

has-color-system.reason: A complete baseline token set is only created when none exists; an existing-but-incomplete file is left to a human (not advertised as auto-fixable).

has-typography.reason: Font selection is a design choice, not a deterministic default.

custom-font-loaded.reason: Fetching/self-hosting a typeface is not a deterministic edit; font selection is a design choice.

has-logo.reason: Logo image generation is non-deterministic and requires AI or a human asset.

has-favicon.reason: Self-contained: derived from an existing logo. When no logo exists it is honestly guidance-only (autofix not advertised).

no-template-residue.reason: Default Vite favicon/title residue is removed deterministically; lorem-ipsum copy stays a manual finding.

asset-validity.reason: Flattening/re-encoding an icon or generating an icon set is an image transform left to the brand-projection path.

referenced-assets-exist.reason: A dangling reference is fixed by shipping the missing image bytes, which cannot be synthesized deterministically.

svg-asset-safety.reason: Stripping nodes from a hand/tool-authored SVG can silently break its rendering, so sanitizing stays a human decision.

apple-touch-icon.reason: A home-screen icon is a branded visual asset and should be derived from the approved brand/logo source, not invented by validation.

public-asset-convention.reason: Branding/PWA/OG assets and their references are deterministically relocated under /public/ (ui/public/public) and repointed, so an edge Access bypass can serve them to anonymous fetchers.

wcag-aa-contrast.reason: Re-balancing a palette to pass AA requires design judgment, not a mechanical edit.

dark-mode-contrast.reason: Re-balancing the dark palette to pass AA requires design judgment.

reduced-motion-support.reason: A uniform prefers-reduced-motion reduce block is appended to the existing design tokens; when no tokens file exists it is guidance-only.

brand-markers-applied.reason: Applying markers is brand-projection: it needs an assigned brand via the apply domain, which the served validation path has no input for, so it is guidance-only here.

theme-color-present.reason: The missing-entirely case is auto-injected; deriving a dark-scheme variant value is left guidance-only.

ios-statusbar-safe-area.reason: Injects viewport-fit=cover + a safe-area-inset token deterministically; the runtime render is out of scope (ui-health/device harness).

manifest-completeness.reason: Scalar fields are filled from identity + house defaults; missing icons require a logo and stay guidance-only.

social-preview-image.reason: A share-card image requires a branded 1200x630 asset or approved visual composition, so validation only reports the missing surface.

cli-branding.reason: Human-facing CLI help copy is a writing decision, not a deterministic default.

api-branding.reason: The API/OpenAPI title (service.description) is human-authored product copy.
